notes: Plum centre x~1189 (faces 1074/1304), Elm centre x~2791 (faces 2675/2907; the two pipes at ~2757 and ~2819 are not centred; a pasted white strip along the west side of Elm reaches x~2737 but the block face is 2675). Jogs at Elm: West 8th (53', faces 892/1077, centre 985) ends at Elm from the west; east of Elm the street is the 126' Garfield Place (faces 979/1419, centre 1199, dashed park outline in the middle; name printed on sheet 45, not here), so two T points. George (50', centre 3107) ends at Elm from the west; east of Elm Shillito Place (name from sheet 45, ~49 ft, no width printed here; faces 2970/3138, centre 3054) - two T points 53 px apart. L'Hommedieu Alley (printed L'HOMMEDIEU ALLEY, 12') runs Plum to Elm at y~2796-2803; at Plum it is offset from the Central-to-Plum alley of sheet 43 (centre 2736 here) and at Elm from the east-of-Elm continuation (~10 ft, centre 2688; sheet 45 prints L'HOMMEDIEU ALLEY), each piece recorded as its own T. Piatt Alley (name from sheet 45, ~12 ft, faces 1755/1798) and Borden Alley (sheet 45 prints BORDEN ... ALLEY, ~11 ft, faces 3390/3428) enter Elm from the east only. Cathedral Alley (10' on sheet 43) enters Plum from the west only (faces 1757/1792); no opening east of Plum. West 6th is 120' from Plum to Elm (faces ~3550/3970, centre ~3760) with a market house (orange block, 42' roadway printed north of it) in the middle of the street, and 66' east of Elm (faces 3735/3966, centre 3850); the south face is continuous. Elm/West 6th is therefore given as the middle of the four block corners (2791,3804), ~45 px off each centreline (same treatment as Central/6th on sheet 43); Plum/6th uses the 120' centreline. West 7th printed 66' (one label west of Elm may read 56'); 8th west of Plum has no separate width label. NAMING: West 8th here is the 53' piece that jogs north at Central on sheet 43, so it is named 'West 8th Street (east of Central)' as there; the Plum-to-Elm L'Hommedieu piece is 'L'Hommedieu Alley (Plum to Elm)' (sheet 43 uses the same name for its Plum T) so it is not joined to the plain L'Hommedieu Alley that runs Mound to Central.
